title: Run of the silent return machine
statement: Let $\iota$ embed the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, and let the distinguished tape index $\mathrm{cap}$ lie outside the image of $\iota$. For an $m$-tape machine $M$ and configuration $c$ whose state is present, suppose that $M$ is still in a state at every time $t<T$ and has halted at time $T$. Starting from the embedded configuration with its state mapped into the left summand, the return machine's run agrees, at every time $t<T$, with the embedding of $M$'s configuration at time $t$ (again with state in the left summand); at time $T$ it is the embedded halted configuration with state set to the right-summand return state. At every time before $T$, its state is not that return state.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding $\iota$ from the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
The distinguished index $\mathrm{cap}$ is outside the image of $\iota$
Background tape contents and head positions, a prefix and initial output, and an initial configuration $c$
The initial state of $c$ is present
The run of $M$ is nonhalted at every time $t<T$
The run of $M$ is halted at time $T$
